theme.description: The wiki creator's preferred theme. Render with it when it is set. Fall back to your own default when it is missing or the name is unfamiliar.

homeSlug.description: Slug of the note shown as the wiki's front page. Defaults to 'home'.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag for the wiki content (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'ja').

visibility.description: public: anyone can read the wiki. private: only the owner and members can. Controls what the appview serves; records stay readable in the author's repo either way, so treat it as access control.

description.description: Short description of the wiki's purpose or topic.

translations.description: Other-language editions of this wiki, each the at-uri of a wiki.lichen.wiki record. Directional: list this wiki on the target to link back. Name only public wikis — this record is world-readable.

main.description: A wiki. The rkey is a permanent slug.
